rule: the paired FPR and FNR conditions of docs/design.md §6 as proposed: the reference's FPR on its own snapshot, r, held fixed, and the FPR and FNR changes on the same examples bounded by the interval paired_coverage.py chooses. Lines unchanged: r + the FPR change's upper bound <= 2 x target for PASS, the FNR change's upper bound <= +0.05. The ΔAUROC condition is unchanged
committed_before: any run of the paired rule. The interval's own coverage bar is in paired_coverage_expected.json
if_a_bar_fails: the paired rule doesn't ship, the current rule stays, the miss is published, and nothing is retuned
comparison: every run reads the current rule and the paired rule on the same seeds and resamples, and reports both

seeds.planted_fault_planting: unchanged at seed 0, so the faults are the same rows as planted_faults.md
seeds.not_used: settle 0 to 999 and 2,000 to 2,999 (extensions at +3,000,000), the flip check and planted faults 0 to 999, the shift note's 1,000 to 1,999

synthetic_gate.generator: tests/synthetic.py unchanged_scorer, threshold fitted on each seed's reference benign scores
bars: the null and the fresh-engine noise case PASS in at least 99% of seeds, at each size

every bound of docs/results/phase1/gate_calibration.md still holds at 1,191 benign and 910 attacks: non-PASS <= 10% for the null and fresh-engine noise, STALE >= 90% at a true FPR of 5%, PASS <= 1% at 3% and 5%, and for the missed-attack cases SCORER DEGRADED >= 80% and PASS <= 1% at ΔAUROC -0.05 and -0.1, and SCORER DEGRADED <= 5% at -0.01
FNR rises of 0.10 and 0.15 at 180 and 910 attacks: non-PASS no lower than the current rule's minus 1 point
reported_without_bar: FPR at 1.5x and 2x the target, and FNR rises of 0.02, 0.04, 0.05 and 0.06, at both sizes
each seed's discordant counts for the null

bars: an unchanged rerun of the promoted candidate is non-PASS in at most 10% of seeds, in each cell, against 43% under the current rule at 180 per class
the 'not calibrated on this snapshot' warning in at most 1%, in each cell
promotion_round_trip.consequence: if both hold, Recalibration.attacks_needed and its warning are removed

settle_rows.cases: settle_v2's FNR rises of 0.04 (population inside the line) and 0.06 (past it) at 180 benign and 180 attacks, a 5% target, from experiments/phase2/settle_validation.py at b78cc65
settle_rows.reads: the FNR condition at n, then on the same seed extended with fresh examples at the original threshold to 2x, 5x and 10x the data
settle_rows.wrong_way: settled on the side opposite the case's population side
bars: the paired rule settles the wrong way in at most 3% of all seeds, per case and size
among settled seeds, the paired rule's wrong-way share is no higher than the current rule's on the same seeds at every size, and lower at n
settle_rows.expectation_before_the_run: by a normal approximation, not a measurement: at n, about 4% of settled seeds wrong for the 0.04 rise (current rule 11.8% in settle_v2) and about 7% for 0.06 (current 9.3%). settle_v2's bar of at most 1% of settled seeds isn't used, since no valid 95% bound meets it at 180 for a truth 0.01 from the line
reported_without_bar: settle_v2's ΔAUROC -0.025 row, which the paired rule doesn't touch
each seed's per-seed truth at its fitted threshold, since the case's side is set by population values

planted_faults.harness: experiments/phase4/probe/planted_faults.py, both splits, threshold refit on each resample's reference benign scores, 1,000 resamples per row
planted_faults.expected_verdicts: planted_faults_expected.json unchanged. On population values the paired rule and the current rule agree, since the candidate's rate is the reference's plus the change
bars: null rows non-PASS in at most 5% of resamples, on each split, so test's 11.8% must clear the bar
gross rows: the expected verdict in at least 95% of resamples
gross either-verdict rows: non-PASS in at least 95% of resamples
graded rows whose population verdict is THRESHOLD STALE or SCORER DEGRADED: PASS no more than the current rule's on the same resamples plus 1 point
reported_without_bar: every graded row under both rules

held_out.bar: no check whose current verdict is PASS becomes non-PASS, and every verdict that changes is listed with its cause
